verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say reviews can be triggered manually or automatically, with control over when they run on a pull request (qodo-docs-26). Org- and repo-level portal settings and .pr_agent.toml configuration-as-code provide a place to set this behaviour (qodo-docs-10, qodo-docs-11), and the CLI allows on-demand review before a PR is opened (qodo-docs-5). However, the evidence never shows the specific controls the story names, and the default is to automatically review every PR (qodo-docs-1). Missing for 10: documented draft-PR skipping, branch-based filtering, label-based trigger filtering, a specific on-demand PR comment command, independent corroboration.
